descricao: --output-indicator-* só muda o texto do diff e as opções de leitura do ls-remote: libera.

tool_input.command: git log -1 -p --output-indicator-new=x --output-indicator-old=y --output-indicator-context=z && git ls-remote --heads --tags --refs --symref -q --exit-code --sort=-v:refname origin develop
